coordinate_contract.unity: metres; X/Y/Z with Y up; imported asset root local frame
coordinate_contract.pose_format: local_position_m[3], local_rotation_xyzw[4] relative to the dedicated PanelMotion parent
coordinate_contract.closed: normalized drive=0; panels physically seal the aperture
coordinate_contract.open: normalized drive=1; all panels clear the declared walk aperture
coordinate_contract.root_origin: one documented rigid frame per door at the aperture center; include its local pose relative to static airlock/building root
coordinate_contract.preserve_static_ORG_children: shell, ramp, lamps, light buttons, core architecture stay fixed

colliders.moving_panels: dedicated colliders parented to each motion transform; never static-combine these panels; no inherited old shell collider sealing the open aperture
colliders.occupancy_sensors: separate fixed trigger volumes on the aperture; do not parent sensors to moving panels
colliders.body_room_volume: separate fixed room-local BoxCollider volume, distinct from door and button colliders

room_interface: chamber_volume_segments: fixed root-local boxes, all with room_id EVA_EAST_01.CHAMBER; exact point-in-box union, never union AABB
audio_contract: separate physical event and propagation route; pressure affects air conduction only, not all helmet/radio/structure channels; source recordings identified honestly
network_contract: explicit stable airlock/button/panel IDs, never runtime instance IDs; server owns pressure, door state and validation; poses are client presentation of authoritative normalized door state
cloud_delivery_minimum: reuse existing 12 mesh panels; include both outer and core-layer inner assembly, closed AND open pose data, dedicated dynamic colliders, fixed room/aperture sensors and new button/indicator anchors; retain original static parents
temporary_local_module: replaceable graybox module using the same IDs and pose API until final cloud assembly arrives; no overwrite of formal map or existing optimized building prefab
volume_union_policy: Multiple BreathableZone objects can share one AirspaceId/controller. Query membership in any individual box; no trigger enter/exit counters, so overlaps cannot remove atmosphere prematurely.
